# Fix: the "Update app now" button in the tablet check never appeared
### Fixed
- **The "Update app now" button in the tablet check never appeared** (bug since 2.35.0). The rows of the tablet check did not know their own id, so the page did not know next to which row the button belongs. Every row now carries id, status and value; a test pins this down.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
